training.failure_policy: Generate and record both pools for every pose even if L0 fails; both arms fail a layer iff N<=4 and succeed a template iff both layers succeed; P/B success statuses must match; zero-success object or extraction exception blocks quality

unchanged.source_pyramid: cv::pyrDown to floor-half current source dimensions
unchanged.NMS_semantics: exact V11 row-major mask-before-traversal suppression state over D; not separately within S/I
unchanged.official_box_metadata: unchanged warped-mask bbox and pose geometry

mask_semantics.V0: actual CV_8UC1 official warped mask bytes
mask_semantics.Vnext: cv::resize(Vcurrent, floor-half current source size, 0, 0, INTER_NEAREST)
mask_semantics.M_l: V_l != 0 after the exact per-layer nearest resize
mask_semantics.signed_distance: exact integer Chebyshev distance to opposite-valued pixel with zero exterior; inside boundary+1 and adjacent outside-1

candidate_pool.radius_basis: 7x7 Gaussian then3x3 Sobel center support; not fitted to V30 outcomes and not a bound on all selection dependencies
candidate_pool.D: nonzero M_l dilated by9x9 all-one kernel with constant0 exterior, intersect unchanged2-pixel NMS-loop margin
candidate_pool.pool_collection: one shared RGB gradient/angle pyramid; accepted C uses unchanged strong-threshold strict comparison and angle validity plus original NMS loop; C immutable for both samplers

sampling.initial_seed: eligible greatest finite float32 magnitude, then smallest accepted ordinal
sampling.selection: maximize minimum checked int64 squared Euclidean distance to entire selected set; tie descending float32 magnitude then ordinal
sampling.duplicate_position_fixture: input ordinals remain distinct, zero squared distance valid; real collector visits coordinate once

B.borrowing: if |S|<qS transfer deficit fromS toI; then if |I|<qI transfer deficit fromI toS; N>=t guarantees final quotas fit counts and sumt
B.scheduler: alternate S,I startingS; skip fulfilled stratum without output; select within requested stratum using global selected-set distance

sampling.post_selection: unchanged cross-layer cropTemplates; preserve selection order, label and theta bits; C0 never normalized

candidate_evidence.raw_masks: complete lossless uint8 V_l arrays including0/nonzero byte values, saved once per pool with shape/hash
candidate_evidence.compression: lossless gzip, no sampling/quantization/truncation; ordered shard membership and content+compressed hashes
candidate_evidence.streaming: one pose/layer pool in memory, both samplers before release; never retain all pools in RAM
candidate_evidence.split_policy: at pool boundaries only; if a single pool exceeds ceiling fail rather than recode/split mid-run

resource_limits.hard_guard_scope: all native output/temp files, logical bytes and process-wide RSS; preallocation checks plus runtime watchdog
resource_limits.exceed: preserve counters/reservation/partial/current shards and fail incomplete; quality forbidden; revised-resource successor must be explicit, no silent rerun

geometry.planner: scan actual features and own-layer origins for all C0/P/B banks; deterministically enlarge right/bottom only when required by actual max+1 geometry
geometry.stop: resource failure or unexpected C0 candidate difference; no feature/pose filtering
geometry.common_padding_C0_gate: all evaluated C0 raw fields/order/float32 bits must exactly equal V30 common-padding control; if not, primary interpretation stops

quality.old_gate: C0 only, original848x672,6objects x8frames x2paths; exact old raw required
quality.pilot: all3arms x6objects x8frames x2paths; correctness/execution only, no parameter/arm selection
quality.development: all3arms x6objects x400frames x2paths, full raw and selected evidence including empty/negative cases
quality.primary_hypothesis: B allGT TP>=215 AND FP<42112 after exact common-padding C0 reproduction
required_reports: allGT/eligible precision recall F1 TP FP FN IGNORE
full ordered raw fields and float32 scores

timing.after: complete independent quality audit; accuracy failure still permits cost measurement but never promotion
timing.rotation: start=(fixed timing-frame ordinal + round_index) mod6; variants rotate cyclically from this start
timing.every_call_reference: full ordered raw fields/float32 bits equals own frozen development arm/path reference

independent_correctness.oracle: standard-library only; full candidate/mask payloads, own nonzero/distance/stratum/quota logic, exhaustive full pairwise-distance recomputation; no native sampler imports or native stratum trust
required_RED: resource guard or missing shard acceptance
independent_correctness.candidate_pixel_limitation: real RGB gradient magnitudes/candidate acceptance are native observations, not independently regenerated pixels; literal gradient/NMS maps provide separate semantic tests
independent_correctness.quality_audit: recompute complete raw order, scores, metadata boxes,NMS,GT/eligible/IGNORE,negatives,identities and aggregates
independent_correctness.timing_audit: recompute all route/order/warmup/count/statistic records; CSV does not reconstruct full per-call outputs

private_regression.scope: existing local magnetic/SMD regression kept separate and unchanged
private_regression.execution: separate fresh bounded regression plan/CPU reservation before native execution; no private image reads in this design

promotion: false; full development/timing results are required first and industrial generalization needs a separately frozen untouched held-out protocol
